transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: Our reading club used to select a new book every week, but most members couldn't finish it in time.

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: Starting next month, we'll read one book every two weeks. That should give everyone more time to prepare, although we'll discuss fewer titles.

transcript.speaker: Leo

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Yesterday I left home early for a job interview. My train stopped between stations because of a signal problem, and the driver said we might wait for twenty minutes. I called the company immediately, explained the delay and asked whether I could arrive a little late. The receptionist thanked me for calling and moved my interview to eleven. The train started again ten minutes later, so I arrived before the new time.

questions.promptPt: Como a pessoa resolveu o problema do atraso?

options.label: Pegou um táxi sem avisar ninguém
Avisou a empresa e teve o horário alterado

questions.evidence: called the company; interview moved to eleven

questions.promptPt: Qual foi a causa da parada do trem?
O que aconteceu depois de o trem voltar a andar?
questions.evidence: arrived before the new time

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: When I applied for an internship last month, I thought my application was complete. A few days later, the recruiter explained that my CV had arrived but the portfolio file was missing. I checked my email and realised that the attachment was too large to send. I uploaded the portfolio to a shared folder and sent a link instead. The recruiter confirmed that they could open it and invited me to an interview.

questions.promptPt: Qual problema ocorreu na inscrição?

options.label: O portfólio não chegou à empresa
O currículo foi enviado para outra pessoa

questions.promptPt: Como a pessoa resolveu o problema?
questions.modelPt: Enviou um link para uma pasta compartilhada.
acceptedExamplesPt: Fez upload do arquivo e mandou o endereço.
questions.essentialEvidence: uploaded the portfolio to a shared folder and sent a link

questions.promptPt: Qual foi o resultado final declarado?
questions.evidence: invited me to an interview

transcript.speaker: Organiser
transcript.text: This Saturday we're organising a clean-up by the river. We expected to start at eight in the morning, but the weather service now predicts heavy rain until ten. If the rain continues after eleven, we'll clean the indoor storage area instead.
